item.title: [No Priors] Redefining Chip Architecture with Arm CEO Rene Haas
item.description:
Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:15 There's no computing problem that's ever been invented that doesn't utilize and can't utilize the microprocessor. It is the heart of everything. All roads lead through it, around it, past it. Something has to do the orchestration, arbitration decision around where those tokens go. That's what CPUs do.
